# UI Design Specification: "Our Commitment" Page

## Overall Layout & Structure
- **Layout**: Single-column vertical flow with centered content
- **Background**: #F5F5F0 (light beige/cream)
- **Max-width**: 1140px
- **Margin**: 0 auto (horizontal centering)
- **Padding**: 4rem 2rem (top/bottom, left/right)

## Typography System
- **Primary Font**: 'Inter', sans-serif (Google Fonts)
- **Secondary Font**: 'Georgia', serif (for subtle emphasis)

### Heading Styles
- **Main Title**: 
  - Font: 'Inter', 64px, 700 (bold)
  - Color: #2D3748 (dark slate gray)
  - Letter-spacing: -0.02em
  - Line-height: 1.2
  - Margin-bottom: 2.5rem

- **Subheading**:
  - Font: 'Inter', 24px, 400 (regular)
  - Color: #4A5568 (gray-600)
  - Line-height: 1.5
  - Margin-bottom: 4rem

### Section Headings
- Font: 'Inter', 18px, 600 (semibold)
- Color: #2D3748
- Letter-spacing: 0.05em
- Text-transform: none
- Margin-bottom: 1rem

### Body Text
- Font: 'Inter', 16px, 400
- Color: #4A5568
- Line-height: 1.6
- Margin-bottom: 1.5rem

## Color Palette
- **Background**: #F5F5F0 (light cream)
- **Primary Text**: #2D3748 (dark slate)
- **Secondary Text**: #4A5568 (gray-600)
- **Accent**: #E2E8F0 (light gray)
- **Dividers**: #CBD5E0 (gray-400)

## Spacing System
- **Vertical rhythm**: 1rem base unit
- **Section spacing**: 4rem between sections
- **Content padding**: 2rem horizontal
- **Grid gutters**: 2rem between columns

## Section Structure
Three equal-height sections arranged vertically with consistent spacing:

### Section 1: Quality Gear
- **Icon**: Gear outline (SVG, #CBD5E0, 24px)
- **Layout**: 
  - Left: Icon + "Quality Gear" heading
  - Center: "Top-notch Equipment" subheading
  - Right: Descriptive paragraph
- **Border-bottom**: 1px solid #CBD5E0
- **Padding-bottom**: 4rem

### Section 2: Expert Advice
- **Icon**: Lightbulb outline (SVG, #CBD5E0, 24px)
- **Layout**: Same as Section 1
- **Border-bottom**: 1px solid #CBD5E0
- **Padding-bottom**: 4rem

### Section 3: Customer Support
- **Icon**: Heart outline (SVG, #CBD5E0, 24px)
- **Layout**: Same as Section 1
- **Border-bottom**: None

## Interactive Elements
- **Hover states**: 
  - Icons: #A0AEC0 (gray-500) on hover
  - Text: #2B6CB0 (blue-600) on hover
- **Transition**: 0.2s ease-in-out

## Visual Hierarchy
1. Main title (largest, boldest)
2. Subheading (medium, regular)
3. Section headings (small, semibold)
4. Descriptive text (smallest, regular)

## Design Tokens
- **Border radius**: 0px (sharp corners)
- **Box shadow**: None
- **Font weights**: 400 (regular), 600 (semibold), 700 (bold)
- **Line heights**: 1.2, 1.5, 1.6
- **Letter spacing**: -0.02em (title), 0.05em (section headings)

## Responsive Considerations
- **Breakpoint**: 768px
- **Layout**: Single column (stacked)
- **Font sizes**: 
  - Title: 48px
  - Subheading: 20px
  - Section headings: 16px
  - Body: 14px

## Accessibility
- **Contrast ratio**: 14.1:1 (meets WCAG AA)
- **Focus states**: Visible outline on interactive elements
- **ARIA labels**: Applied to all interactive components

## Additional Elements
- **Floating element**: Small "About" card in bottom-right corner (light yellow background, subtle shadow)
- **Position**: Fixed, bottom-right corner
- **Size**: 120px × 80px
- **Z-index**: 1000

This design maintains a clean, professional aesthetic with a focus on readability and clear information hierarchy, using a limited color palette and consistent spacing to create visual harmony.
